title: A Whole Has Parts Inside It
objective: A single quantity (a whole) can be seen as made of smaller quantities (its parts) without changing how many there are in total.
studentQuestion: Can you find two smaller groups inside this one?
newIdea: Part/whole — a whole physically split into two visible parts.

teaching.setup: 7 counters in one group, counted together.
teaching.see: This whole group is 7. What if I slide some of them apart?
teaching.break: Physically slide the group into two visibly separate parts (e.g. 5 and 2).
teaching.build: Count each part; notice they're still sitting inside what used to be the 7.
teaching.transform: Same 7 — now seen as two parts instead of one whole.

check.prompt: Push the two parts back together and recount — still 7.

examples.transfer: A group the learner splits themselves, in a way not yet shown.

mastery.evidence: Correctly predicts the whole is unchanged after a physical split, across two examples.
